profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mercury
profile.summary:
Software engineer with solution architect experience, leading software development projects on multiple tech stacks. I have worked for large companies in the first years of my career and started my own back in 2004.

I work well independently or in a group, highly motivated and always looking for a new challenge. Having my own company showed me that the best technical approach for a solution is that which satisfies the customer, and meets the business and financial objectives of the company.

Currently focused on Functional Programming technologies like Haskell and Scala, and building high performance and scalable software platforms. Exposure to Docker, K8S, TF and cloud services (mainly AWS).

Past experiences with Java/JVM and C/C++.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bootstrapped both the Venture Debt and E-commerce working capital products. From design to implementation and production. Pairing with EMs and PMs on defining scope, priorities and building those two lending products in a green-field mode. 

Part of the team responsible for the international wires platform. 

Tech stack: Haskell, React and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and build highly distributed systems using Scala and Akka. Applying techniques like Cluster Sharding, CQRS and event sourcing to handle concurrency, Kafka to communicate with external services, Akka Streams for stream and batch processing, and Akka Cluster to allow transparent horizontal scaling. 

Deployment technologies involve Docker and K8S, running on Amazon AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading the dev team of our rules-based integration platform and coordinating the delivery of this product to the company first client.

The platform runs based on a large set of AWS services, like EC2/ECS, ECR, Cloudwatch, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, KMS and RDS (MySQL and PostgreSQL). 

Other technologies involved: Scala, Java, Docker, Apache Camel, Spring boot, Jackson/Json, JPA, JBoss Rules, Kafka, Apache Flink.

positions.title: Owner/Solution Architect
positions.description:
Pre-sales presentations, and project scoping and estimates to prepare proposals and RFQs/RFPs.

Assessment and proof-of-concepts on the adoption of new technologies. Some of the latest chosen ones are Scala, Play!Framework, Akka + Streams, Angular.IO and MongoDB.
75% of de time doing code review, technical coaching and development tasks.

I currently code in Java and Scala, deploying on Play!Framework or Spring and persisting information in one of the following RDBMS: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB, both on local servers or AWS instances. Some of the technologies I use are JPA/Hibernate, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS/SASS, RequireJS, AngularJS and Angular.io, Bootstrap, MomentJS, JBoss BRMS.  I also acted on backend only projects processing XML and CSV files in high volume multi-threaded environments.

In the last few years, I have ventured in the AWS world deploying projects using EC2, EBS, RDS, S3, CloudFront. 

The majority of our projects are for the big players of the Brazilian telecom market, processing large sets of data in a multi-threaded environment, running thousands of validation rules to detect fraud, inconsistencies or unusual scenarios in the billing statements, prior to printing and sending them to the final customers. Therefore, our software is part of a critical path for those companies, affecting in their revenue inflow.

positions.title: Development Architect
positions.description:
Telecom billing provider based on Cincinnati (USA), working on implementation projects at VIVO (largest South American mobile company), Brazil Telecom and JetBlue (USA).

I had worked along with the pre-sales team answering to RFP and RFQ from different telecom companies around South and Central America. My responsibility was to check and answer all technical aspects of the RFQ/RFP and point were the product needed any customization to meet the customers' requests, and to prepare a high level estimate of such customizations so that the pre-sales and sales teams could compute the total project cost and timeline.

During this period, I also led the implementation of one of the company's product in a Brazilian telecom. I was responsible for the design of the customization components and had to lead the Java developers while they were coding those components.

I had a 3-month experience teaming with the core Java developers in USA, working on the integration components of the billing solution of the company. Main technologies used back then was Java, JSP/Servlets and Oracle running on a Weblogic app server.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Java developer for the billing & rating department. 

My most significant projects at Nextel were a dispute system used by Nextel call center and the integrated business platform used as a gateway API by other software to provision new customers and services on both the billing system and telecom network.

I developed all these projects using Java as programming language and Oracle as the RDBMS. Whenever we needed to create web applications, we used Struts and eventually some core Servlet classes. 

My team and I introduced the use of JBoss as the application server at Nextel.

Specifically for the business platform, we had to connect to a CORBA bus to interact with the billing system and we created a component following the JCA standards (Java Connector Architecture) to connect with the telecom network.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description: Automatos was a startup to automate the tasks of system management and capacity planning on servers remotely. I was the lead developer for the web portal that all customers use to manage their assets (servers, storages, network elements, etc.)
